title: Electricity and deployment bottlenecks
scope: Eight new electricity/grid documentary source families. Seven have inspected source-reported sample records; EirGrid has verified archive/methodology metadata with sample-row and rights holds. Publisher claims do not constitute independent physical validation.
source_snapshot_limit: Selected primary text and metadata inspected. Origin-document/workbook byte identities remain unverified; local capture hashes are not raw source hashes. No visual-QA claim, whole workbook, private customer data or source corpus is included.
third_party_rights: Artifact-specific permissions remain separate. Public access, an open-data label, software/documentation licensing and utility disclosure do not supply blanket redistribution clearance.
verdict: Retain eight new documentary families. Prioritize ERCOT, Georgia PSC and EirGrid for analytical value while retaining EirGrid row/rights holds and blocked ERCOT August/Batch Zero values as unverified. EIA, CSO tables and the LBNL data file have the clearest scoped reuse basis. One conditional two-PDF ERCOT specification remains deferred; no physical-capacity or operational-compute series is admitted.

baseline_inventory.scope: Frozen 64-family inventory and relevant research catalogs. Existing CoreWeave SCB008 findings reused without repeating source research.

priority_ranking.basis: Analytical missing evidence, not acquisition permission or verification completeness. EIA/CSO/LBNL have strongest scoped reuse basis.

ranking_basis: Analytical missing evidence, not acquisition permission or verification completeness. EIA/CSO/LBNL have strongest scoped reuse basis.
interpretation_guards: Commercial commitment, planning approval, construction, electrical energization and operation are independent dimensions; retain proposed/applied/conditional/contracted distinctions.
Power (MW/GW), energy (MWh/GWh), voltage (kV), grid-connection limit, IT load, nameplate/net-summer supply and measured demand require distinct quantity bases; no automatic conversion.
Facility total load includes non-IT equipment; no IT-load or usable-compute conversion without explicit facility PUE/boundary/time and utilization evidence.
Supply queue MW cannot become delivered data-center capacity. Generation commissioning does not establish allocation to a customer.
Tariff eligibility, rate schedules and transport offers do not prove realized demand. Contracted power can overlap active power.
All physical outcomes remain publisher/operator/statistical-source reports, not independent on-site or meter validation by this review.
Preserve entity grain, parent/phase/subproject IDs, operator request IDs, source revisions, geographic scope and reporting vintage before aggregation.
Separate event/expected/achieved dates, observation interval, source snapshot, document/publication and retrieval times. Historical event dates do not establish historical forecast availability.

Public availability is not permission to redistribute. Do not acquire private customer/meter information, reidentify redactions, bypass access errors or add new source families after this final original review.
Unknown AI use remains unknown. No GPU/FLOP inference, universal operational-compute total, capacity utilization ratio or p(doom) calculation.
